entries.mitigation: Get in the water and swim before it detonates. Blocking will not save you.
entries.notes: Rapid Deluge is survived by being in swimming state at detonation; official U34 patch history says it cannot be blocked.

entries.mitigation: Dodge or block the tracked wave. Do not eat it unblocked.
entries.notes: Reviewed veteran evidence records dodge/block as valid responses and says an unblocked hit can be fatal.

entries.mitigation: Stay in healing and heal through the six-second ramping damage window.
entries.notes: Reviewed veteran evidence records a six-second duration, ramping damage, and an explicit heal check.

entries.mitigation: Send the portal team immediately and get the channeler to 50% before the 60-second Dreadsail Ascension wipe.
entries.notes: Current reviewed guide evidence places bridge phases at 50%, 35%, and 20% and gives the channeler team 60 seconds to reach 50% health before the group wipe.

entries.mitigation: Keep stamina available and break free immediately if Lure of the Sea fears you toward the water.
entries.notes: Current guide evidence records two Sirens and a fear/pull mechanic whose response is Break Free.

entries.mitigation: Off-tank the Sea Behemoth and kill it promptly; its dangerous ground areas disappear when it dies.
entries.notes: Current guide evidence says the Sea Behemoth spawns on the main tank, is handled by the off-tank, and its Arctic Annihilation areas disappear on death.

entries.mitigation: Roll-dodge the heavy attack. The dodge creates a low-damage water spout instead of taking the heavy hit.
entries.notes: Current guide labels this heavy attack Coral Slash; FoundryDock keeps the reviewed Coral Slam identity and records the guide naming as source-specific evidence.

entries.mitigation: Keep Taleria faced away from the group. The frontal cone hits twice and refreshes Soaked Wound on targets it catches.
entries.notes: Current guide evidence records a frontal cone, two hits, and a Soaked Wound DoT refreshed by repeated hits.

entries.mitigation: Use the opposite-element dome on the enemy and keep the fire and ice domes from touching.
entries.notes: Reviewed dome evidence requires opposite-element protection and records an overload when opposing domes touch.

entries.mitigation: Use the opposite-element dome on the enemy and keep the fire and ice domes from touching.
entries.notes: Reviewed dome evidence requires opposite-element protection and records an overload when opposing domes touch.

entries.mitigation: Keep the taunt target away from the group while the acid pools drop. Do not stack extra players into it.
entries.notes: Reviewed evidence records the taunt target as the primary target, persistent acid pools, stacking acid vulnerability, and extra pools when additional players are caught.

entries.mitigation: Kill the Reef Heart before the 60-second timeout or Empowered Rockfall wipes the group.
entries.notes: Reviewed evidence records a 60-second Reef Heart timeout ending in a group wipe from Empowered Rockfall.
